overall: The AG declined to review the untimely minutes-accuracy complaint and found no violation on the unannounced recordings, because the secretary never told the chair she was recording.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the minutes of the November 3, 2014 meeting were inaccurate because they omitted a discussion that took place during the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaint was not filed until May 19, 2015, we find that this allegation is untimely, and we decline to review it.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board recorded three meetings without first informing members of the public that they were being recorded.
allegations.key_passage: However, because the Secretary did not inform the chair that she was making these recordings, the chair was not obligated to inform the public.
